captions.caption: A close-up of a fire burning inside a primitive clay oven as a hand enters the frame.
A hand pushes a bundle of dry reeds into the fire burning inside a clay oven.
The hand pushes the burning reeds further into the clay oven.
A hand brings a wooden stick to add to the fire in the clay oven.
The hand pushes the stick into the fire to help it burn.
The hand withdraws after adding the stick to the fire.
The camera tilts up to show the top of the blackened clay oven.
A shot of the top of the clay oven with green foliage in the background.
A close-up shot looking down into the blackened chimney of the clay oven.
A static close-up view of the inside of the dark, blackened oven chimney.
A static close-up view of the inside of the dark, blackened oven chimney.
A view from inside a dark hut, showing a shirtless man crouching outside in the sun.
The silhouetted man crouches and tends to items on the ground outside the hut.
The silhouetted man shifts his weight while crouching outside the hut.
The silhouetted man continues to move while crouching, seen from inside the dark hut.
The silhouetted man moves around in a crouching position in the sunlight.
The silhouetted man crouches down, his movements obscured by the shadows.
The silhouetted man picks something up and continues to move while crouching.
The silhouetted man places an item down near the oven.
A close-up of the clay oven as hands bring a pan into view.
A pair of hands places a turtle-shaped clay pan filled with chopped cactus onto the oven.
The hands adjust the clay pan on top of the hot clay oven.
The pan of chopped green cactus sits on the clay oven to cook.
A wide shot of a shirtless man standing next to the clay oven and a thatched hut.
The man crouches down next to the clay oven.
The man remains crouched near the oven, partially hidden by a bush.
The man, still crouched, picks something up from the ground.
The man holds a small, dark object in his hand.
The man reaches up to place the object on the clay oven.
The man places a small clay bowl onto the top of the oven.
The man finishes placing the bowl and moves away.
A close-up of the oven top with the pan of cactus and a bowl of quail eggs.
A static close-up of the uncooked quail eggs and chopped cactus.
A static close-up of the uncooked quail eggs and chopped cactus.
A static close-up of the uncooked quail eggs and chopped cactus.
A close-up shot of the chopped green cactus cooking in the clay pan.
A static close-up shot of the chopped green cactus cooking in the clay pan.
A close-up shot of the small clay bowl filled with several speckled quail eggs.
A static close-up of the quail eggs, with the cooking cactus blurred in the background.
A static close-up shot of the quail eggs in the small clay bowl.
A man's head and shoulders appear from behind the clay oven.
The man leans over the oven, looking down at the food.
The man approaches the oven, holding a wooden spatula.
The man begins to stir the chopped cactus with the wooden spatula.
A close-up of the man's soot-stained hand stirring the cactus.
The man continues to stir the cactus in the turtle-shaped pan.
The man continues stirring the cactus in the pan.
A wider shot shows the shirtless man standing by the oven and stirring the food.
The man continues to stir the cactus on the oven.
The man stops stirring and rests the spatula.
The man stands by the oven, watching the food cook.
A close-up shot of the man's hand stirring the cactus again.
The man stirs the cactus, moving it around the clay pan.
The man lifts the spatula after stirring the cactus.
The man's hand reaches for the bowl of quail eggs.
The man's hand hovers over the bowl of quail eggs.
The man picks up a single quail egg from the bowl.
The man's hand holds the small, speckled quail egg.
The man's hand moves the quail egg towards the pan of cooking cactus.
The man's hand brings the quail egg down towards the cooking pan.
